enVersion: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.he: מַשְׂכִּיל לְאָסָף הַאֲזִינָה עַמִּי תּוֹרָתִי הַטּוּ אׇזְנְכֶם לְאִמְרֵי פִי
enLines: Maschil of Asaph. Give ear, O my people, to my teaching; Incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

verses.he: אֶפְתְּחָה בְמָשָׁל פִּי אַבִּיעָה חִידוֹת מִנִּי קֶדֶם
enLines: I will open my mouth with a parable; I will utter dark sayings concerning days of old;

verses.he: אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְנוּ וַנֵּדָעֵם וַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ סִפְּרוּ לָנוּ
enLines: That which we have heard and known, And our fathers have told us,

verses.he: לֹא נְכַחֵד מִבְּנֵיהֶם לְדוֹר אַחֲרוֹן מְסַפְּרִים תְּהִלּוֹת יְהֹוָה וֶעֱזוּזוֹ וְנִפְלְאֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
enLines: We will not hide from their children, Telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, And His strength, and His wondrous works that He hath done. .

verses.he: וַיָּקֶם עֵדוּת בְּיַעֲקֹב וְתוֹרָה שָׂם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶת אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְהוֹדִיעָם לִבְנֵיהֶם
enLines: For He established a testimony in Jacob, And appointed a law in Israel, Which He commanded our fathers, That they should make them known to their children;

verses.he: לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּ דּוֹר אַחֲרוֹן בָּנִים יִוָּלֵדוּ יָקֻמוּ וִיסַפְּרוּ לִבְנֵיהֶם
enLines: That the generation to come might know them, even the children that should be born; Who should arise and tell them to their children,

verses.he: וְיָשִׂימוּ בֵאלֹהִים כִּסְלָם וְלֹא יִשְׁכְּחוּ מַעַלְלֵי אֵל וּמִצְוֺתָיו יִנְצֹרוּ
enLines: That they might put their confidence in God, And not forget the works of God, But keep His commandments;

verses.he: וְלֹא יִהְיוּ כַּאֲבוֹתָם דּוֹר סוֹרֵר וּמֹרֶה דּוֹר לֹא הֵכִין לִבּוֹ וְלֹא נֶאֶמְנָה אֶת אֵל רוּחוֹ
enLines: And might not be as their fathers, A stubborn and rebellious generation; A generation that set not their heart aright, And whose spirit was not stedfast with God.

verses.he: בְּנֵי אֶפְרַיִם נוֹשְׁקֵי רוֹמֵי קָשֶׁת הָפְכוּ בְּיוֹם קְרָב
enLines: The children of Ephraim were as archers handling the bow, That turned back in the day of battle.

verses.he: לֹא שָׁמְרוּ בְּרִית אֱלֹהִים וּבְתוֹרָתוֹ מֵאֲנוּ לָלֶכֶת
enLines: They kept not the covenant of God, And refused to walk in His law;

verses.he: וַיִּשְׁכְּחוּ עֲלִילוֹתָיו וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר הֶרְאָם
enLines: And they forgot His doings, And His wondrous works that He had shown them.

verses.he: נֶגֶד אֲבוֹתָם עָשָׂה פֶלֶא בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם שְׂדֵה צֹעַן
enLines: Marvellous things did He in the sight of their fathers, In the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

verses.he: בָּקַע יָם וַיַּעֲבִירֵם וַיַּצֶּב מַיִם כְּמוֹ נֵד
enLines: He cleaved the sea, and caused them to pass through; And He made the waters to stand as a heap.

verses.he: וַיַּנְחֵם בֶּעָנָן יוֹמָם וְכׇל הַלַּיְלָה בְּאוֹר אֵשׁ
enLines: By day also He led them with a cloud, And all the night with a light of fire.

verses.he: יְבַקַּע צֻרִים בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיַּשְׁקְ כִּתְהֹמוֹת רַבָּה
enLines: He cleaved rocks in the wilderness, And gave them drink abundantly as out of the great deep.

verses.he: וַיּוֹצִא נוֹזְלִים מִסָּלַע וַיּוֹרֶד כַּנְּהָרוֹת מָיִם
enLines: He brought streams also out of the rock, And caused waters to run down like rivers.

verses.he: וַיּוֹסִיפוּ עוֹד לַחֲטֹא לוֹ לַמְרוֹת עֶלְיוֹן בַּצִּיָּה
enLines: Yet went they on still to sin against Him, To rebel against the Most High in the desert.

verses.he: וַיְנַסּוּ אֵל בִּלְבָבָם לִשְׁאׇל אֹכֶל לְנַפְשָׁם
enLines: And they tried God in their heart By asking food for their craving.

verses.he: וַיְדַבְּרוּ בֵּאלֹהִים אָמְרוּ הֲיוּכַל אֵל לַעֲרֹךְ שֻׁלְחָן בַּמִּדְבָּר
enLines: Yea, they spoke against God; They said 'Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

verses.he: הֵן הִכָּה צוּר וַיָּזוּבוּ מַיִם וּנְחָלִים יִשְׁטֹפוּ הֲגַם לֶחֶם יוּכַל תֵּת אִם יָכִין שְׁאֵר לְעַמּוֹ
enLines: Behold, He smote the rock, that waters gushed out, And streams overflowed; Can He give bread also? Or will He provide flesh for His people?'

verses.he: לָכֵן שָׁמַע יְהֹוָה וַיִּתְעַבָּר וְאֵשׁ נִשְּׂקָה בְיַעֲקֹב וְגַם אַף עָלָה בְיִשְׂרָאֵל
enLines: Therefore the LORD heard, and was wroth; And a fire was kindled against Jacob, And anger also went up against Israel;

verses.he: כִּי לֹא הֶאֱמִינוּ בֵּאלֹהִים וְלֹא בָטְחוּ בִּישׁוּעָתוֹ
enLines: Because they believed not in God, And trusted not in His salvation.

verses.he: וַיְצַו שְׁחָקִים מִמָּעַל וְדַלְתֵי שָׁמַיִם פָּתָח
enLines: And He commanded the skies above, And opened the doors of heaven;

verses.he: וַיַּמְטֵר עֲלֵיהֶם מָן לֶאֱכֹל וּדְגַן שָׁמַיִם נָתַן לָמוֹ
enLines: And He caused manna to rain upon them for food, And gave them of the corn of heaven.

verses.he: לֶחֶם אַבִּירִים אָכַל אִישׁ צֵידָה שָׁלַח לָהֶם לָשֹׂבַע
enLines: Man did eat the bread of the mighty; He sent them provisions to the full.

verses.he: יַסַּע קָדִים בַּשָּׁמָיִם וַיְנַהֵג בְּעֻזּוֹ תֵימָן
enLines: He caused the east wind to set forth in heaven; And by His power He brought on the south wind.

verses.he: וַיַּמְטֵר עֲלֵיהֶם כֶּעָפָר שְׁאֵר וּכְחוֹל יַמִּים עוֹף כָּנָף
enLines: He caused flesh also to rain upon them as the dust, And winged fowl as the sand of the seas;

verses.he: וַיַּפֵּל בְּקֶרֶב מַחֲנֵהוּ סָבִיב לְמִשְׁכְּנֹתָיו
enLines: And He let it fall in the midst of their camp, Round about their dwellings.

verses.he: וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׂבְּעוּ מְאֹד וְתַאֲוָתָם יָבִא לָהֶם
enLines: So they did eat, and were well filled; And He gave them that which they craved.

verses.he: לֹא זָרוּ מִתַּאֲוָתָם עוֹד אׇכְלָם בְּפִיהֶם
enLines: They were not estranged from their craving, Their food was yet in their mouths,

verses.he: וְאַף אֱלֹהִים עָלָה בָהֶם וַיַּהֲרֹג בְּמִשְׁמַנֵּיהֶם וּבַחוּרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִכְרִיעַ
enLines: When the anger of God went up against them, And slew of the lustieth among them, And smote down the young men of Israel.

verses.he: בְּכׇל זֹאת חָטְאוּ עוֹד וְלֹא הֶאֱמִינוּ בְּנִפְלְאוֹתָיו
enLines: For all this they sinned still, And believed not in His wondrous works.

verses.he: וַיְכַל בַּהֶבֶל יְמֵיהֶם וּשְׁנוֹתָם בַּבֶּהָלָה
enLines: Therefore He ended their days as a breath, And their years in terror.

verses.he: אִם הֲרָגָם וּדְרָשׁוּהוּ וְשָׁבוּ וְשִׁחֲרוּ אֵל
enLines: When He slew them, then they would inquire after Him, And turn back and seek God earnestly.

verses.he: וַיִּזְכְּרוּ כִּי אֱלֹהִים צוּרָם וְאֵל עֶלְיוֹן גֹּאֲלָם
enLines: And they remembered that God was their Rock, And the Most High God their redeemer.

verses.he: וַיְפַתּוּהוּ בְּפִיהֶם וּבִלְשׁוֹנָם יְכַזְּבוּ לוֹ
enLines: But they beguiled Him with their mouth, And lied unto Him with their tongue.

verses.he: וְלִבָּם לֹא נָכוֹן עִמּוֹ וְלֹא נֶאֶמְנוּ בִּבְרִיתוֹ
enLines: For their heart was not stedfast with Him, Neither were they faithful in His covenant.

verses.he: וְהוּא רַחוּם יְכַפֵּר עָוֺן וְלֹא יַשְׁחִית וְהִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁיב אַפּוֹ וְלֹא יָעִיר כׇּל חֲמָתוֹ
enLines: But He, being full of compassion, forgiveth iniquity, and destroyeth not; Yea, many a time doth He turn His anger away, And doth not stir up all His wrath.

verses.he: וַיִּזְכֹּר כִּי בָשָׂר הֵמָּה רוּחַ הוֹלֵךְ וְלֹא יָשׁוּב
enLines: So He remembered that they were but flesh, A wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.

verses.he: כַּמָּה יַמְרוּהוּ בַמִּדְבָּר יַעֲצִיבוּהוּ בִּישִׁימוֹן
enLines: How oft did they rebel against Him in the wilderness, And grieve Him in the desert!

verses.he: וַיָּשׁוּבוּ וַיְנַסּוּ אֵל וּקְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הִתְווּ
enLines: And still again they tried God, And set bounds to the Holy One of Israel.

verses.he: לֹא זָכְרוּ אֶת יָדוֹ יוֹם אֲשֶׁר פָּדָם מִנִּי צָר
enLines: They remembered not His hand, Nor the day when He redeemed them from the adversary.

verses.he: אֲשֶׁר שָׂם בְּמִצְרַיִם אֹתוֹתָיו וּמוֹפְתָיו בִּשְׂדֵה צֹעַן
enLines: How He set His signs in Egypt, And His wonders in the field of Zoan; .

verses.he: וַיַּהֲפֹךְ לְדָם יְאֹרֵיהֶם וְנֹזְלֵיהֶם בַּל יִשְׁתָּיוּן
enLines: And turned their rivers into blood, So that they could not drink their streams.

verses.he: יְשַׁלַּח בָּהֶם עָרֹב וַיֹּאכְלֵם וּצְפַרְדֵּעַ וַתַּשְׁחִיתֵם
enLines: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; And frogs, which destroyed them.

verses.he: וַיִּתֵּן לֶחָסִיל יְבוּלָם וִיגִיעָם לָאַרְבֶּה
enLines: He gave also their increase unto the caterpillar, And their labour unto the locust.

verses.he: יַהֲרֹג בַּבָּרָד גַּפְנָם וְשִׁקְמוֹתָם בַּחֲנָמַל
enLines: He destroyed their vines with hail, And their sycamore-trees with frost.

verses.he: וַיַּסְגֵּר לַבָּרָד בְּעִירָם וּמִקְנֵיהֶם לָרְשָׁפִים
enLines: He gave over their cattle also to the hail, And their flocks to fiery bolts.

verses.he: יְשַׁלַּח בָּם חֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ עֶבְרָה וָזַעַם וְצָרָה מִשְׁלַחַת מַלְאֲכֵי רָעִים
enLines: He sent forth upon them the fierceness of His anger, Wrath, and indignation, and trouble, A sending of messengers of evil.

verses.he: יְפַלֵּס נָתִיב לְאַפּוֹ לֹא חָשַׂךְ מִמָּוֶת נַפְשָׁם וְחַיָּתָם לַדֶּבֶר הִסְגִּיר
enLines: He levelled a path for His anger; He spared not their soul from death, But gave their life over to the pestilence;

verses.he: וַיַּךְ כׇּל בְּכוֹר בְּמִצְרָיִם רֵאשִׁית אוֹנִים בְּאׇהֳלֵי חָם
enLines: And smote all the first-born in Egypt, The first-fruits of their strength in the tents of Ham;

verses.he: וַיַּסַּע כַּצֹּאן עַמּוֹ וַיְנַהֲגֵם כַּעֵדֶר בַּמִּדְבָּר
enLines: But He made His own people to go forth like sheep, And guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

verses.he: וַיַּנְחֵם לָבֶטַח וְלֹא פָחָדוּ וְאֶת אוֹיְבֵיהֶם כִּסָּה הַיָּם
enLines: And He led them safely, and they feared not; But the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

verses.he: וַיְבִיאֵם אֶל גְּבוּל קׇדְשׁוֹ הַר זֶה קָנְתָה יְמִינוֹ
enLines: And He brought them to His holy border, To the mountain, which His right hand had gotten.

verses.he: וַיְגָרֶשׁ מִפְּנֵיהֶם גּוֹיִם וַיַּפִּילֵם בְּחֶבֶל נַחֲלָה וַיַּשְׁכֵּן בְּאׇהֳלֵיהֶם שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
enLines: He drove out the nations also before them, And allotted them for an inheritance by line, And made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

verses.he: וַיְנַסּוּ וַיַּמְרוּ אֶת אֱלֹהִים עֶלְיוֹן וְעֵדוֹתָיו לֹא שָׁמָרוּ
enLines: Yet they tried and provoked God, the Most High, And kept not His testimonies;

verses.he: וַיִּסֹּגוּ וַיִּבְגְּדוּ כַּאֲבוֹתָם נֶהְפְּכוּ כְּקֶשֶׁת רְמִיָּה
enLines: But turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers; They were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

verses.he: וַיַּכְעִיסוּהוּ בְּבָמוֹתָם וּבִפְסִילֵיהֶם יַקְנִיאוּהוּ
enLines: For they provoked Him with their high places, And moved Him to jealousy with their graven images.

verses.he: שָׁמַע אֱלֹהִים וַיִּתְעַבָּר וַיִּמְאַס מְאֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל
enLines: God heard, and was wroth, And He greatly abhorred Israel;

verses.he: וַיִּטֹּשׁ מִשְׁכַּן שִׁלוֹ אֹהֶל שִׁכֵּן בָּאָדָם
enLines: And He forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, The tent which He had made to dwell among men;

verses.he: וַיִּתֵּן לַשְּׁבִי עֻזּוֹ וְתִפְאַרְתּוֹ בְיַד צָר
enLines: And delivered His strength into captivity, And His glory into the adversary's hand.

verses.he: וַיַּסְגֵּר לַחֶרֶב עַמּוֹ וּבְנַחֲלָתוֹ הִתְעַבָּר
enLines: He gave His people over also unto the sword; And was wroth with His inheritance.

verses.he: בַּחוּרָיו אָכְלָה אֵשׁ וּבְתוּלֹתָיו לֹא הוּלָּלוּ
enLines: Fire devoured their young men; And their virgins had no marriage-song.

verses.he: כֹּהֲנָיו בַּחֶרֶב נָפָלוּ וְאַלְמְנֹתָיו לֹא תִבְכֶּינָה
enLines: Their priests fell by the sword; And their widows made no lamentation. .

verses.he: וַיִּקַץ כְּיָשֵׁן אֲדֹנָי כְּגִבּוֹר מִתְרוֹנֵן מִיָּיִן
enLines: Then the Lord awaked as one asleep, Like a mighty man recovering from wine.

verses.he: וַיַּךְ צָרָיו אָחוֹר חֶרְפַּת עוֹלָם נָתַן לָמוֹ
enLines: And He smote His adversaries backward; He put upon them a perpetual reproach.

verses.he: וַיִּמְאַס בְּאֹהֶל יוֹסֵף וּבְשֵׁבֶט אֶפְרַיִם לֹא בָחָר
enLines: Moreover He abhorred the tent of Joseph, And chose not the tribe of Ephraim;

verses.he: וַיִּבְחַר אֶת שֵׁבֶט יְהוּדָה אֶת הַר צִיּוֹן אֲשֶׁר אָהֵב
enLines: But chose the tribe of Judah, The mount Zion which He loved.

verses.he: וַיִּבֶן כְּמוֹ רָמִים מִקְדָּשׁוֹ כְּאֶרֶץ יְסָדָהּ לְעוֹלָם
enLines: And He built His sanctuary like the heights, Like the earth which He hath founded for ever.

verses.he: וַיִּבְחַר בְּדָוִד עַבְדּוֹ וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ מִמִּכְלְאֹת צֹאן
enLines: He chose David also His servant, And took him from the sheepfolds;

verses.he: מֵאַחַר עָלוֹת הֱבִיאוֹ לִרְעוֹת בְּיַעֲקֹב עַמּוֹ וּבְיִשְׂרָאֵל נַחֲלָתוֹ
enLines: From following the ewes that give suck He brought him, To be shepherd over Jacob His people, and Israel His inheritance.

verses.he: וַיִּרְעֵם כְּתֹם לְבָבוֹ וּבִתְבוּנוֹת כַּפָּיו יַנְחֵם
enLines: So he shepherded them according to the integrity of his heart; And lead them by the skilfulness of his hands.
